optimizedDescription.value: DocumentNode indexes searchable non-code text with stable workspace or reserved root: graph identity.

optimizedContext.value:
# Document Model

## Rules
- `DocumentNode` represents textual non-code project resource; MUST include unique `path`, project-root-relative `configRelativePath`, SHA-256 `contentHash`, raw searchable `content`, owning `workspace`.
- Reserve `root:` node prefix and `root` workspace for project-global files found through `graph.includePaths` but owned by no workspace. Identity: `root:<project-relative-path>`.
- During indexing, file matching no registered language adapter becomes `DocumentNode` only when textual. Binary file produces no graph node.
- Exclude filesystem-backed repository directories exposed by `specsPath` from file/document discovery. Index spec artifacts only through spec indexing; never also as `DocumentNode`.
- Graph search API MUST treat documents as first-class category and support including or excluding `DocumentNode` results.

## Constraints
- By default, `DocumentNode` produces no symbol nodes or structural relations such as `CALLS` or `DEPENDS_ON` code.
- `DocumentNode.path` MUST NOT collide with `FileNode.path` in same workspace.
- Normal spec workspaces cannot use reserved workspace name `root`.
- File owned by workspace `codeRoot` MUST NOT also be indexed as `root:` document.
